name: Anantara Villa Padierna Palace
insider_take: This Andalusian palace isn't just a hotel—it's where Tuscan elegance meets Costa del Sol glamour, complete with its own championship golf courses and a world-class racquet club.
whats_special: Built in authentic Tuscan Renaissance style, this palatial resort features three 18-hole golf courses designed by Michael Campbell, plus Spain's largest racquet club with 10 tennis courts and 4 paddle courts. The property sits dramatically on a hilltop with panoramic views of the Mediterranean and Gibraltar.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at La Loggia restaurant—the terrace offers unobstructed views of the Rock of Gibraltar and Morocco's coastline on clear days.
dont_miss: The award-winning Anantara Spa featuring authentic Thai treatments, and a day trip to nearby Ronda—one of Spain's most dramatically situated white villages, perched on a 400-foot cliff just 30 minutes away.
pros: Palatial Tuscan-style villa architecture with opulent interiors
Prime location in Marbella's prestigious Benahavis area
Multiple gourmet dining options and exceptional service
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Expansive resort layout requires walking or shuttle transport
